title: Hackers Exploit Two GeoServer Flaws as Researchers Warn of Unauthenticated RCE Chains
content_md: Threat actors are actively exploiting two newly patched security flaws in GeoServer, according to watchTowr. The vulnerabilities in question are CVE-2026-120705 and CVE-2026-129243, details of which are below - CVE-2026-120705 (CVSS score: 8.6) - An arbitrary file read vulnerability that could enable an attacker to access local text files readable by the GeoServer process or fetch

CVE-2026-120705.evidence: The Hacker News cites watchTowr reporting threat actors actively exploiting the newly patched GeoServer arbitrary file read flaw.

CVE-2026-129243.evidence: The Hacker News cites watchTowr reporting threat actors actively exploiting the second newly patched GeoServer flaw in an unauthenticated RCE chain.
